reviews.review: 10/10 Realy good, a bit grindy at times but when you can get around that, is is one of the best, if not the best F2P out there.
I haven't played in awhile, im afraid if i do.. i'll get sucked in for another 3000 hours

Ok so, let me ask you guys one thing. Would you like to,
1. Be a ninja.
2. Be a ninja in the future.
3. Be able to do all those ninja jumps and flips without having to press thousands of keys.

Well i can safely say Warframe delivers this and a lot more, being able to complete many missions with a variety of weapons including many different melee weapons starting with a standard sword. 
Now of course maybe you're thinking, i've heard from others it's pay to win, not true, paying to win should only apply to games that are mainly PVP. Warframe does have a PVP mode but it's priority is on a COOP scale. You may use money to buy many new things such as warframes (your class) or different weapons, attachments, colours, skins, pets, sentinels, components, parts for your warframe, etc.

But don't be put off by this, the games unique because almost anything you can buy with Platinum (the ingame money you used your well earned cash on), you can buy with Credits which as you guessed is the standard money set for the game. Lets say you want a new melee weapon but you don't want to spend any real money on this because you're unsure how the game may turn out, well you can purchase "blueprints" for nearly anything in the game. So you purchase a new sword blueprint with your credits, now! You can't just jump in with creating it, because you need components, and to retrieve these components you need to do missions! However different planets have different components so you need to play missions to unlock more missions that will unlock more planets thus getting more components. Now if you're still with me you can now use new said components to create your sword you've worked so hard for, but now you have to wait maybe 12 hours for this sword to create, so now it's up to you whether you relax or carry on playing to get more components for even more items! Then we'll fast foward and VOILA! Your new sword is ready for combat.

Now, the leveling up system, your weapons all have a max rank of 30, or at least thats where mine say max rank, your warframe however can get much higher but there's somewhat of a twist to this. Like on most shooters today, you get to a max rank and then can "prestige" as most of us know it to be, but with this say you get to level 10, you then take a test to prove to "The Lotus" that you are capable of using your weapons so you'll use your primary weapon to fight numerous waves of enemies. When you have completed this you'll be level 10 still but next to your name will be "1", then again with level 20 you'll take another test and then instead of "1" it will now be "2"...complicated enough? nah you guys are smart. 

Mods, use these to make your weapons stronger and your warframe more powerful, mods are slotted in when available, hence needing to level up your gear. These mods can cause more damage, elemental attributes, quicker speed, longed range etc...etc. 

If this wasn't enough you can also obtain "Sentinels" and "Kubrows" to fight alongside you and of course these guys can be upgraded as well. But to obtain them you must complete missions further on in the game to accomplish this task!

Bottom line this game might need a lot of grinding but at least you get the feeling of achievement, you've put your time and hard work into gathering the components to create a new weapon because you liked the look of it, now you can use that weapon to succeed in more missions to then create even more weapons or warframes. 

So if my review has peaked your interest in wanting to try out for yourself then feel free to, if you don't fancy having a go then no problem, my review is not meant to be persuasive but informative. 

Enjoy Warframe :)

played it for a few hours, seems like a cool game

Edit: Now for a ''real'' review.

Is the game flawless? No. There are many flaws with the game, but it's still a fun game. It's just a game that will keep you busy when you have some time to kill.

When I started playing warframe, I had no one to play with (that was a few months after it came out) but I still enjoyed playing it. After an incident with my PC, I wasn't able to play for about 2 years. When I came back to see everything new in the game, I was excited to return. But this time I wanted to try and get someone else to join me, and after months and months of bothering my friend, he decided to try it out and now he's like me. Over 1000 hours and loves the game as much now as the first time he tried it.

TL;DR it's a fun game, pretty much always something to do. Better with friends.
